about.title: The Label Priasha by Priya
about.intro: The Label Priasha by Priya is rooted in slow fashion and the beauty of handcrafted textiles.
paragraphs: Each piece is thoughtfully designed with an appreciation for traditional techniques, beautiful fabrics and the hands behind the craft.
The label celebrates clothing that feels personal rather than disposable — pieces made to be worn, loved, restyled and remembered.
From everyday silhouettes to customized designer pieces, Priya works closely with clients to create clothing that reflects their individuality.

values.name: Slow fashion
values.description: Thoughtful collections over fast trends, with an emphasis on longevity and intentional buying.

values.name: Handcrafted detail
values.description: A love for textiles, texture and the small details that make a garment feel special.

values.name: Personal design
values.description: Customization and personal conversations are part of the experience — from concept to final piece.
